cr50: make EC RST synchronous When the RBOX register controlling the EC reset output is written, RBOX does not act immediately, as it is controlled by its own clock. This results in the program continuing executing before RBOX output value change. This patch makes sure that execution does not continue until RBOX reacted to the request to change the EC RST output value. BRANCH=cr50. cr50-mp BUG=b:75976718 TEST=verified with logic analyzer that processing does not continue until EC RST output value changes. binhost_test: overhaul AssertChromePrebuilts output The current failure message looks like: ERROR: eve-paladin cannot find Chrome prebuilts -- <long CompatId object> This then requires people to manually load up all the configs and see what should have matched and what changed. Lets improve this output by doing some of that precalculation ourselves. Now we have: ERROR: eve-paladin cannot find Chrome prebuilts (probably due to USE flags mismatch) Build settings: <long CompatId object> Closest matching configs: Boards: <BoardKeys> USE changes: <list of USE flag differences> Build settings <long CompatId object> Boards: <BoardKeys> USE changes: <list of USE flag differences> Build settings <long CompatId object> ...more... The CompatId object can be long, so it can still make these things wrap together. But hopefully this somewhat structured output should be enough for developers to dig through quickly. BUG=chromium:872351 TEST=precq passes Change-Id: I1be7d4cdf190998d64dce3f4705bd6da4587b428 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1213642 Commit-Ready: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org> Tested-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Lann Martin <lannm@chromium.org>
